aesthetic.outcome: Hull rails/planks, ribs and fastening hardware read as substantial worn constructed pieces with rounded or faceted soft edge volume. Improve weak proportions and construction where useful; counts and original boxes are not locked.

Keep observed blue/cyan hull, dark slate structure and pale metal accents. Warm cream wear highlights are restrained. Avoid shifting the whole family to yellow rock or creating deep featureless black regions.

Broad soft value changes describe native volume in every facing with no preferred horizontal illumination. Highlights follow material and form without white glare, glowing fringe or directional ground shadow.

Purposeful shallow grain, chips, dents or bevel wear communicate wreck age and distinguish hull from hardware. Detail supports the large form and remains coherent at phone32; do not require literal ImageGen cracks.

At logical128 the continuous hull construction and hardware hierarchy are immediately legible, and at phone32 the asset still reads as a wreck section rather than blue stripes with black holes. Four views form one native object.

All4 independent repeated sprites and actual consumer joins are clean on light/gray/dark. Reject narrow local cut lines, alpha punctures, doubled rims/endcaps, abrupt normals/material fields, clipping and unrelated repeat decoration. A small numerical residual does not waive a visible seam.

hardContract: Actual ordered finite port profiles and authored handedness, native ground support and admissible clearance/envelope, root and world scale, registered camera/matrices/frame/aspect/cell, all4 facings and static timing. Source endpoint materials/normals may be redesigned coherently as a future canonical family field; geometry is fixed. Measured proposal follows in preparation-v1.
